svg.title: Mixture labels can switch while predictions agree
svg.desc: Swapping component names leaves a two-component mixture density unchanged.
svg.text: Mixture labels can switch while predictions agree
Swapping component names leaves a two-component mixture density unchanged.
For equal weights: ½N(x;−2,0.7²)+½N(x;2,0.7²) is invariant to exchanging labels 1 and 2.
Blue: identical predictive density in both panels
